# Module: `icescopy_inptk_client`

Communicates with a separately installed INP toolkit process through queued requests.

[Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_client.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Starts the executable in serve mode and checks its advertised capabilities. Process I/O and JSON serialization run on a worker thread; callbacks return to the client thread. Request identifiers and connection generations keep replies associated with the operation that submitted them. Calculation code remains in the external toolkit.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`ToolkitTransport`](API-Class-ToolkitTransport.md) | Runs the toolkit process and exchanges newline-delimited JSON on a worker thread. |
| [`InptkClient`](API-Class-InptkClient.md) | Queues toolkit requests and delivers results to the analysis window. |
